cast.title: Fame: The Musical
cast.overview: Based on the 1980 phenomenal pop culture film, Fame The Musical is the international smash hit sensation following the lives of students at New York's High School For The Performing Arts as they navigate their way through the highs and lows, the romances and the heartbreaks and the ultimate elation of life.

cast.title: National Theatre Live: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead
cast.original_title: National Theatre Live: Rosencrantz & Guildenstern Are Dead
cast.overview: Against the backdrop of Hamlet, two hapless minor characters, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, take centre stage.  As the young double act stumble their way in and out of the action of Shakespeare’s iconic drama, they become increasingly out of their depth as their version of the story unfolds.
